text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I ran away. Yes... I ran away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has confronted being a Mejiro in their own way.
And yet I...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —I ran away. Because I wasn't strong enough to face what I loved.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—Out there. Out beyond the Mejiro name.
To a place where even a weak girl like me can truly be myself...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That place was certainly found.
However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because I ran away, my weakness showed in the Tenno Sho (Spring).
I couldn't overcome it, so I couldn't be true to myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If I keep going like this, will I truly
become the person I'm meant to be? And that me is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Can I truly—be someone to be "proud of"?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Vrooooom!
Besties, you're totally coming to karaoke with me♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And I'm totally hyping myself up before the Takarazuka Kinen!
This is it! ☆ Totally nailed it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry.
Today's a bit...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ehhhh, fr? What a drag...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then what about our boba run?! Our UmaTok shoots?!
What about our dessert-only conveyor belt sushi tour?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm, none of these really hit the mark...

"In contrast to Daitaku Helios's enthusiastic invite,
the response came back rather flat."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey... isn't this boring?
Are you tired of hanging out with me, Bestie?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Or, could it be...
you've fallen for me!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, I do like you...
Of course I love you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So... that's why we've been able to have fun all along.
By running away from the painful places.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because I keep leaning on my bestie,
I've stayed weak all this time...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No way...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"So what if it is? Having fun
isn't a bad thing at all! Everyone wants to live
doing what they love!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's totally normal to ditch places that suck!
If we just have fun running and have fun winning...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin, you got stronger! For real!
Totally! You're just lacking confidence vibes! So...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't... become strong at all...
You're only saying that to be nice..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Geez... Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fine, whatever! Palmer, you big idiot—!!
You absolute numbskull!!!!!!!
Daitaku Helios dashed off somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I thought I was running away, but maybe I never really got anywhere at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My weak self follows me everywhere. And
one day, she'll definitely strike me from behind, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: McQueen and Ryan never ran away; they kept honing themselves. That's why they can truly be proud of who they are...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still, you know, I found myself just wanting to have fun, right? So the weight of time I've put in just feels lacking, or something..."

Indeed, depending on how you look at it,
having fun might have been a way of running away.
Even so—
choice_data_list: I think it was time we needed, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Necessary? Time to enjoy oneself?
choice_data_list: Front runners catch their breath along the way, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Front Runners need to pace their breathing, huh...
Ahaha, I see. Nicely put!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I didn't even know
how to take a breather.
It was so suffocating...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still! Taking a detour into freestyle taught me the joy of running as my heart desires—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
By trying all sorts of things I'd never experienced before,
I was able to learn more about myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You might be right about it being necessary.
Thanks to that, I was able to start over from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Starting over just means
I'm still way behind, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If I keep feeling inferior to McQueen and Ryan... I just can't get into the groove...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If I can't proudly say, "Front running is the best! How do ya like me now?",
I can't just go and party in front of them...

The silence was heavy. —Show them some strength.
A strength unique to Mejiro Palmer, who walked a different path from the other Mejiro Umamusume...
"Unless that is found, Mejiro Palmer will..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer.
Wanna have a quick chat...?"

An ambush in the dead of night.
It seems they were waiting for me to arrive.
And the two of them talked. About everything they could do for Mejiro Palmer.
And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
About the next race, maybe after all...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ‘Sup! Gotta talk to ya!

Daitaku Helios came walking over,
radiating deep, bass-heavy vibes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah, Helios... Sorry about the other—...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No need to apologize! More importantly!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Look, Palmer-chin. You've got things that only you have.
It's totally, definitely a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Besties... if it's comforting you...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm not just comforting you! I know it for a fact!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My bestie's runaway front-running is insane!
Nobody can catch up! That's why—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Running full breakaway like that... was a desperate measure, too.
You could say it was born from my own weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So it's not something special enough
to show off with pride to the Mejiro girls...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No! Because I ran away, on the other side of running away—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: There were tons of things you couldn't see unless you ran in the front! It was a mega, super-sized spectacle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Something you can't see... unless you run in the lead?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Because you ran away, Palmer-chin,
you got to meet Trainer. And you got to meet me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And we've been besties forever! We can handle whatever comes next!
Friendship is totally the strongest, am I right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't an encounter like this unique among the Mejiros?
Only Palmer-chin could pull it off, right? That's why!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because I ran away, I met you...
Because I ran away...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's true. If I had been strong, I never would've met Trainer and my besties...
This is mine alone...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I'm not just any friend.
I know Palmer inside and out☆
Like, all of her!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're crazy fast. Sickest out of anyone☆
Even if you don't believe it, Palmer-chin, I believe in
my BFF's power! Always, always, always!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But... you're overestimating me. I'm really nothing
special. Someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Don't say that!
Palmer, you just don't get it at allll!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I understand you way better than you do!
Way, way better than you know yourself, Palmer-chin!
Because...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I love you waaaaaaaay more
than you love me, Palmer-chin!!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Besties...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna keep telling you until you believe it, Palmer-chin! "Palmer-chin, you're amazing! Incredible! Super-awesome!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
During training, during breaks, in the bath, and
before races! I'll mega-shout from the stands too,
and if that's still not enough...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Even so—if this still isn't enough.

Daitaku Helios pulled out a piece of paper.
The "trump card" she had prepared after consulting with me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'll run right beside her, screaming the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right beside me...? Wait, that paper is... !?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Registration—application form.
For the "Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "I've got a lot of followers, so I can enter the Takarazuka Kinen too. Even though I usually stick to the mile route."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Besties... then...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Are you there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, do I really need that...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Do any of the other Mejiros have a friend like this?!
A friend who'll enter the same race with you!
A friend who'll hype you up right beside you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: This is—I am—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm the one and only front-runner bestie for life
that Palmer-chin has who also ran away!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Front-running... besties for life...
Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: How's this look, Palmer-chin...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't this hype ya up a bit...?
Can't someone like me... make ya proud?

The sun god Daitaku Helios, who once taught me freedom,
is now once again—

It brought light to Mejiro Palmer.
A light that gave meaning to the road she had traveled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
As if I wouldn't be hyped...
There's no way he's here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Being so reckless,
without thinking about the consequences or risks...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
An amazing friend who's always by my side?!!!!
There's no way anyone like that exists anywhere in the world!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Riiiight, bestie?! You see it, right?!
There's something only Palmer-chin has!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real! This is a total treasure!
As long as we're all together, there's nothing to fear!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: So, what do you think of the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...I'm running! Of course I am.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wanna go for a mega run with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—We run!!
As long as the two of us are together...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I can go anywhere and everywhere!!
Nothin' left to do but show 'em all what I've got! That's right—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "A Double Great Escape!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm running in the Takarazuka Kinen!
I might not be good enough right now, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Because I was lacking, I found them!
Besties who fill in those missing pieces for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The two of us are one! This time, together,
we're gonna show off some super confident, vibe-maxed party-people moves!!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayy ayyy☆

Alongside the friend she met through shared struggles,
Mejiro Palmer stood shoulder to shoulder,
heading towards the Takarazuka Kinen.
